cd3ea2c2-d8d0-4a8a-abd4-50872ac721bb.title: Note
cd3ea2c2-d8d0-4a8a-abd4-50872ac721bb.text:
basement = Black Cog
ground floor = Red Cog
1st floor = Blue Cog
2nd floor = White Cog

d7f48d0e-4956-4d02-aa4e-fd9e02e9934e.title: Note
d7f48d0e-4956-4d02-aa4e-fd9e02e9934e.text:
spindles are color coded, cogs will only
fit on 1 cog, otherwise will say
"The cog doesn't seem to fit."

a35dc113-e9d2-45b6-8dde-646bb22b6711.title: Black Cog
a35dc113-e9d2-45b6-8dde-646bb22b6711.text:
when trying to pick it up without a bucket of water:
"The cog is red hot from the flames. You cannot pick it up."
with a bucket of water:
"You pour water over the cog. It quickly cools down enough to take."
you click to continue, and it takes the bucket of water and replaces
it with an empty bucket, and you also recieve the black cog.

a00495ed-a952-418f-822b-017e431b2d8f.title: White Cog
a00495ed-a952-418f-822b-017e431b2d8f.text:
You cant open the western gate it says:
"This door does not seem to be openable."
Need to use poison on the food trough.
upon use, all the rats go to the food trough, then die shortly
afterwards.
"The rats swarm towards the poisoned food...
...and devour it hungrily."
"You see them smashing against the gates in a panic."
"They seem to be dying."
 When you interact with the western door it says:
"The death of the rats seem to have shaken the door loose of
its hinges. You pick it up and go through."
the door is able to be passed through both directions.

930885e4-b39d-4297-8080-d18125268099.title: Note
930885e4-b39d-4297-8080-d18125268099.text: Can't carry more than 1 cog at a time.

c0c4b0c5-6134-4f83-a8b9-cc24d5c4721e.title: Brother Kojo
c0c4b0c5-6134-4f83-a8b9-cc24d5c4721e.text:
Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you
happen to know the time?

f1dc2350-23d1-461b-9f3f-366dd44e7437.title: Brother Kojo
f1dc2350-23d1-461b-9f3f-366dd44e7437.text:
Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down,
and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must
fix it before the town people become too angry!

c8428b2a-eafd-4c0b-a77f-eda868958963.title: Brother Kojo
c8428b2a-eafd-4c0b-a77f-eda868958963.text:
I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll
pay you for your help.

73c406cc-3cdd-4b30-950b-1943f7fadf99.title: Brother Kojo
73c406cc-3cdd-4b30-950b-1943f7fadf99.text:
OK then. Come back and let me know if you change
your mind.

84169288-232d-4b3d-a374-8be6fd5dd210.title: <player>
84169288-232d-4b3d-a374-8be6fd5dd210.text: OK old monk, what can I do?

c6620d0b-720c-48fc-8aed-33120a99aff9.title: Brother Kojo
c6620d0b-720c-48fc-8aed-33120a99aff9.text:
Oh, thank you kind sir!
In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs.
They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to
carry them one at a time.

d659bafa-2cce-41a5-8c07-5d4f8909b374.title: Brother Kojo
d659bafa-2cce-41a5-8c07-5d4f8909b374.text:
I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly
remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm
sure you can figure it out fairly easily.

5185a2b0-8326-416e-b54e-83acd04a9686.title: Brother Kojo
5185a2b0-8326-416e-b54e-83acd04a9686.text:
Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the
cellar is full of strange beasts!

7c51ca77-7a8c-4802-87c5-d57b49c84f65.title: Note
7c51ca77-7a8c-4802-87c5-d57b49c84f65.text: Start Clocktower quest (changes to yellow in log)

0703eb80-ef4a-4a5e-b36d-93a79a1b0fb3.title: Brother Kojo
0703eb80-ef4a-4a5e-b36d-93a79a1b0fb3.text:
Oh hello, are you having trouble? The cogs are in four
rooms below us. Place one cog on a pole on each of the
four tower levels.

6c6eb138-d4ce-4430-b563-95513951628a.title: <player>
6c6eb138-d4ce-4430-b563-95513951628a.text: Right, gotcha. I'll do that then.

cf6219b5-b1fa-455c-bc64-3f1595078db7.title: Brother Kojo
cf6219b5-b1fa-455c-bc64-3f1595078db7.text:
That's great. Come see me when you've done the other
three.

13a7998c-d8c8-4313-aef3-c76879557990.title: <player>
13a7998c-d8c8-4313-aef3-c76879557990.text: I have replaced all the cogs!

af9495e4-a654-4b44-9799-232005d682be.title: Brother Kojo
af9495e4-a654-4b44-9799-232005d682be.text:
Really..? Wait, listen! Well done, well done! Yes yes
yes, you've done it! You ARE clever!

de217453-d662-454a-86a6-2859c1322016.title: Brother Kojo
de217453-d662-454a-86a6-2859c1322016.text:
The townsfolk will all be able to know the correct time
now! Thank you so much for all of your help! And as
promised, here is your reward!

f7ae4a54-47dd-4741-b737-62687e235ba6.title: Brother Kojo
f7ae4a54-47dd-4741-b737-62687e235ba6.text:
Oh hello there traveller. You've done a grand job with
the clock. It's just like new.
